verses.gurmukhi: ਲਜਾ ਕੁਲ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਅਉ ਗੁਰ ਜਨ ਸੀਲ ਡੀਲ ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਬ੍ਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਪਤਿਬ੍ਰਤ ਕਹਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lajaa kul a(n)kas aau gur jan seel ddeel kulaa badhoo brat kai patibrat kahaaviee ||

en.bdb: Because of the good of the family honour, displaying calm and tranquil behaviour before the elders of the house and following the right ethos expected of a married woman, a daughter-in-law of a good family is called faithful and virtuous.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਅਧਮ ਅਸਾਧ ਸੰਗੁ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਬਿਚਾਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਬੁਲਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhusaT sabhaa sa(n)jog adham asaadh sa(n)g bahu bibichaar dhaar ganikaa bulaaviee ||

en.bdb: A woman who keeps company of evil people, doing acts highly condemnable and indulging in licentious deeds is called a whore.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੁਲਾ ਬਧੂ ਸੁਤ ਕੋ ਬਖਾਨੀਅਤ ਗੋਤ੍ਰਾਚਾਰ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਸੁਆਨ ਪਿਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਬਤਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: kulaa badhoo sut ko bakhaaneeat gotraachaar ganikaa suaan pitaa naam ko bataaviee ||

en.bdb: The son of a virtuous woman furthers the family lineage but who can tell the name of the father of a whore's son.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਾਗ ਬਨ ਬਨ ਫਿਰੈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹੰਸ ਏਕ ਟੇਕ ਜਸੁ ਪਾਵਈ ॥੧੬੪॥
verses.translit_en: dhuramat laag jaise kaag ban ban firai gurmat ha(n)s ek Tek jas paaviee ||164||

en.bdb: As a self-willed person of crow-like temperament wanders all over, a Guru-oriented person of swan-like attitude enjoys respect by taking the refuge of Lords name as taught and initiated to him by his Guru. (164)
